node.doctext:
Hash slice from a hashref, into a hashref

ARGH. I want to delete this node; I just realized the question is useless. But I can't figure out how to delete it.

There's another question titled "[id://571688]". However, it's actually asking for a slice of the values of a hash ref. I want a slice of an actual hash. Like this: use strict; use warnings; my %h=(a=>1,b=>2,c=>3); my @x=('a','c'); my $hr=\%h; my %g=%$hr{@x}; # plain old %g = %h{@x} also works my $gr = \%g; print $gr->{a} # prints "1" print $gr->{b} # prints "Use of uninitialized value in print" But I want to load the slice directly into a hashref, not a hash, because my %h is really big and I don't have enough RAM to make a copy of it. I want to do what you might think this would do: my %h=(a=>1,b=>2,c=>3); my @x=('a','c'); my $hr = \%h; my $gr = $hr->{@x}; print $gr->{a} Or maybe one of these: my $gr = $hr{@x}; my $gr = $$hr->{@x}; my $gr = \%{$hr}{@x} Alas, none of these work. Is there a way to get a slice of a hash (not of its values, but of the hash) without making a copy of the hash? Preferably from a hashref to the original hash, since that's what I've got.

I asked a question, then realized that there was no point in asking what I was asking.

So I have deleted it.

Perlmonks.org does not allow deletion of nodes, so here we are.
